# Movie Commentary Workflow v0.4.0

Adds verified shared locks, voice workflow mutual exclusion and bounded Qwen VC preflight, reversible skill upgrades, OCR-to-SRT grouping and an explicit cut-only renderer. The original offline index demo and source release workflow remain available.

The new rendering fixture uses local geometric media and a labelled sine-tone mock narrator; it does not call paid APIs or adopt creative output. `movie_workflow` ships as a Python package, while skills, templates and the original demo still use the complete source tree.

See `docs/execution-tools.md` for input contracts and supported rendering limits. Cloud-provider changes are tested with mocks; real-account billing and voice quality are not revalidated by offline CI.
